weights_rationale: Offer is current_buyer framing: we are surfacing operators / advisors who could SEND Hospitality Stories clients, so destination_overlap is strongly positive (25) - operators already selling Greece or Turkey are the highest-signal matches. source_markets is in low_confidence_fields (inferred from Zurich HQ + travelnews.ch Swiss-German press + UK founder MBA + English-only site), so country is capped at 10 per the prompt rule. icp is high (18) because Hospitality Stories is squarely a FIT / small-group boutique DMC and boutique_advisor / tour_operator are the right primary buyers. travel_type (12) and niche_match (8) capture the luxury / cultural / culinary / sailing / bespoke-experience profile; niche_penalty (10) is moderate to drop wine-only, polar, ski-only, safari-only specialists who clearly do not align with a Greek-islands + Turkey portfolio.
prospect_summary: Hospitality Stories is a Zurich-based boutique experiential DMC operating in Greece and Turkey, founded by Dimitra Vlachou (Athenian, 23+ years in marketing for hotels and cruises) with Pythagoras Nagos as Strategic Advisor / Managing Partner. They design private one-day experiences and immersive multi-day bespoke journeys across the Greek islands (Cyclades, Sporades, Ionian, Dodecanese, Crete, Attica), Bodrum, Cappadocia, and Istanbul, with a focus on local storytelling, hidden gems, culinary tours, sailing charters, and private events. The company positions itself at the premium / boutique end and is built around FIT and small-group travel, making them a natural ground partner for high-end tour operators and luxury advisors selling tailor-made Mediterranean trips.
